name: runner-step-helpers
description: What a spec uses to stay off the developer's live app: the port placeholder gives a free port (the same number everywhere in the run, a named one another), the developer's KOLLAB_WEBUI_HOSTS is not inherited, signal and assert_no_process act only on this run's processes, a second start_app reuses the pane and send_keys F1 sends the key.

steps.description: named ports differ from each other and from the defaults the live app uses
steps.command: if [ {{port}} != {{port:other}} ] && [ {{port}} -gt 10000 ] && [ {{port:other}} -gt 10000 ]; then echo ports-ok; else echo ports-bad; fi

steps.description: the developer's KOLLAB_WEBUI_HOSTS reaches neither a shell step nor the app
steps.command: if /bin/ps axeww -o command= | grep -F 'http.server {{port}} ' | grep -q '[K]OLLAB_WEBUI_HOSTS='; then echo app-hosts-set; else echo app-hosts-unset; fi; echo "shell-hosts=[${KOLLAB_WEBUI_HOSTS-}]"

steps.description: the app is gone after the signal
a second start_app runs its command in the same pane
send_keys F1 sends the key (cat -v shows ^[OP, not the letters F1)
